Its mild yet complex flavors, balanced with aromatic spices and a touch of butter, make it a comforting and incredibly popular choice. This classic recipe delivers restaurant-quality taste right in your home kitchen.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the chicken pieces with yogurt, 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon garam masala, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Mix well to coat the chicken thoroughly. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours for best flavor.

instructions.title: Cook the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken pieces in a single layer, working in batches if necessary to avoid overcrowding. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until lightly browned and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Sauce Base
instructions.text: In the same pan, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of ginger-garlic paste and cook for another minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Simmer the Tomato Sauce
instructions.text: Pour in the tomato puree, remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the oil starts to separate from the sides. This step is crucial for developing deep flavor.

instructions.title: Blend the Sauce (Optional for Smoothness)
instructions.text: For a restaurant-style smooth sauce, carefully transfer the cooked tomato mixture to a blender or use an immersion blender directly in the pot. Blend until completely smooth. Strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve back into the pan for an extra silky texture, discarding any solids.

instructions.title: Combine and Finish
instructions.text: Return the chicken to the smooth tomato sauce. Add the cashew paste, heavy cream, kasoori methi (crushed between your palms), and sugar. Stir well to combine. Simmer gently for another 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the sauce to warm through. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Garnish with fresh chopped cilantro and serve your classic Butter Chicken hot with naan bread, roti, or steamed basmati rice. Enjoy this rich and creamy Indian delicacy!

tips: For the best flavor, marinate the chicken for at least 2-4 hours, or even overnight. This allows the spices and yogurt to tenderize the chicken deeply.
Do not skip blending and straining the sauce if you desire a truly smooth, restaurant-quality texture. It removes any small bits of onion or tomato skin.
Adjust the level of spice by adding more or less red chili powder. For a smoky flavor, you can char the marinated chicken slightly before adding it to the sauce.
Always crush kasoori methi between your palms before adding it to the dish; this releases its aromatic oils and enhances the flavor significantly.
article:
Butter Chicken, known traditionally as Murgh Makhani, is more than just a dish; it's a culinary icon. This beloved Indian chicken recipe has captivated palates worldwide with its rich, creamy, and subtly sweet tomato-based sauce, tender chicken, and aromatic spices. Originating from the bustling kitchens of Delhi, it has transcended borders to become a staple in Indian restaurants and homes across the globe. If you've ever dreamt of recreating that restaurant-quality flavor in your own kitchen, you're in the right place. Get ready to embark on a flavorful journey to master the classic Murgh Makhani.

## What is Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)?
Butter Chicken, or Murgh Makhani (meaning "chicken with butter"), is a quintessential Indian curry that originated in the Moti Mahal restaurant in Delhi in the 1950s. The story goes that the chefs, needing to use leftover tandoori chicken, simmered it in a rich tomato and butter gravy, creating what would become one of India's most famous exports.

At its heart, Butter Chicken is characterized by succulent pieces of chicken (often marinated in yogurt and spices and grilled or pan-fried) bathed in a luxurious, velvety sauce. This sauce is typically made from tomatoes, butter, cream, and a blend of aromatic spices, including garam masala and kasoori methi (dried fenugreek leaves). The result is a mild, subtly sweet, and tangy curry with an unmistakable depth of flavor and a beautiful orange hue, making it a favorite for both spice lovers and those who prefer a milder curry.

## Ingredients for Authentic Butter Chicken
To craft an authentic Butter Chicken, quality ingredients are key. Here's what you'll need:

**For the Chicken Marinade:**
*   **Chicken:** 1.5-2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breast, cut into 1-inch pieces. Thighs are recommended for juiciness.
*   **Plain Yogurt:** 1/2 cup, full-fat.
*   **Ginger-Garlic Paste:** 1 tablespoon.
*   **Spices:** 1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (for color and mild heat), 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder, 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1/2 teaspoon salt.

**For the Makhani Sauce:**
*   **Butter:** 4-6 tablespoons (unsalted, divided).
*   **Oil:** 1 tablespoon vegetable or ghee.
*   **Onion:** 1 large, finely chopped or pureed.
*   **Ginger-Garlic Paste:** 1 tablespoon.
*   **Tomatoes:** 1 (28-ounce) can crushed tomatoes or 4-5 large fresh tomatoes, pureed.
*   **Cashews:** 1/4 cup raw cashews, soaked in hot water for 15 minutes (for creaminess).
*   **Spices:** 1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder, 1 teaspoon garam masala.
*   **Kasoori Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves):** 1-2 teaspoons, crushed between your palms. This is crucial for authentic flavor.
*   **Sugar:** 1-2 teaspoons (to balance tomato acidity).
*   **Salt:** To taste.
*   **Heavy Cream:** 1/2 cup (or more, to taste).
*   **Water:** 1/2 cup or as needed to adjust consistency.
*   **Fresh Cilantro:** For garnish.

## Step-by-Step: How to Make Butter Chicken
Creating the perfect Butter Chicken at home is a rewarding process. Follow these steps for success:

**Step 1: Marinate the Chicken**
In a large bowl, combine the chicken pieces with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, and salt. Mix well to ensure all chicken pieces are coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or preferably 2-4 hours for maximum flavor.

**Step 2: Cook the Chicken**
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil (or butter) in a large skillet or non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken in a single layer, working in batches if necessary to avoid overcrowding. Cook until lightly charred and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per side. Remove cooked chicken and set aside.

**Step 3: Prepare the Sauce Base**
In the same pan (or a large pot), melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the chopped or pureed onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook for another minute until fragrant.

**Step 4: Build the Sauce Flavor**
Add the crushed tomatoes (or fresh puree), soaked cashews, 1/2 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Mix well and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10-15 minutes until the tomatoes have broken down and the sauce thickens slightly. The oil should start to separate from the mixture.

**Step 5: Blend and Strain the Sauce**
Carefully transfer the sauce mixture to a blender. Blend until perfectly smooth. For an extra silky, restaurant-style texture, pass the blended sauce through a fine-mesh sieve back into the pot, pressing down on any solids. Discard any remaining pulp. This step is key for a truly luxurious sauce.

**Step 6: Finish the Makhani Sauce**
Return the strained sauce to the pot over medium-low heat. Add the remaining 2-4 tablespoons of butter, garam masala, kasoori methi (crushed between your palms), and sugar. Stir well and simmer for 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.

**Step 7: Combine Chicken and Cream**
Stir in the cooked chicken pieces and the heavy cream. Add 1/2 cup of water if the sauce is too thick for your preference. Season with salt to taste. Simmer gently for another 5-10 minutes, ensuring the chicken is heated through and absorbs the sauce flavors. Do not boil vigorously after adding cream, as it can curdle.

**Step 8: Garnish and Serve**
Garnish generously with fresh chopped cilantro. Your homemade Butter Chicken is now ready to be enjoyed!

## Tips for the Best Butter Chicken Recipe
Achieving that perfect, restaurant-quality Butter Chicken is easier with a few expert tips:

*   **Don't Skimp on Butter and Cream:** These are defining ingredients of Murgh Makhani. They contribute significantly to the dish's richness and signature texture.
*   **Marination is Key:** A longer marination time for the chicken ensures it's tender and flavorful. If you have time, marinate overnight.
*   **Use Kashmiri Red Chili Powder:** This spice provides a vibrant red-orange color without adding excessive heat, which is characteristic of authentic Butter Chicken.
*   **Blend Until Silky Smooth:** Taking the time to blend the sauce thoroughly and then straining it through a sieve makes a huge difference in achieving that luxurious, smooth consistency.
*   **Toast Kasoori Methi:** Lightly dry-roasting the fenugreek leaves in a pan for a few seconds before crushing and adding them to the sauce enhances their aroma and flavor significantly.
*   **Balance Sweet and Tangy:** The sugar helps balance the acidity of the tomatoes. Taste and adjust to your preference – it shouldn't be overly sweet, just enough to round out the flavors.

## Serving Suggestions & Pairings
Butter Chicken is a versatile dish that pairs beautifully with a variety of accompaniments. For a truly authentic experience, serve it with:

*   **Naan Bread:** Garlic naan, butter naan, or plain naan are perfect for scooping up every last drop of the rich sauce.
*   **Basmati Rice:** Steamed basmati rice or fragrant jeera (cumin) rice provides a wonderful contrast to the creamy curry.
*   **Raita:** A cooling yogurt dip with cucumber and mint can balance the richness.
*   **Kachumber Salad:** A simple salad of diced cucumber, tomato, and onion with a lemon dressing adds a fresh, zesty counterpoint.
*   **Mango Lassi:** A sweet, creamy mango yogurt drink is a classic pairing that complements the mild spices.

## Butter Chicken Variations & FAQs

**Can I make it spicier?**
Yes! If you prefer more heat, add green chilies (slit or minced) to the sauce along with the ginger-garlic paste, or increase the amount of regular red chili powder (not just Kashmiri).

**Can I make it vegetarian?**
Absolutely! Substitute chicken with paneer (Indian cheese), tofu, or even chickpeas for a delicious vegetarian or vegan Murgh Makhani. Adjust cooking times accordingly.

**Does Butter Chicken freeze well?**
Yes, it freezes beautifully! Allow it to cool completely, then transfer to airtight containers. It can be frozen for up to 3 months. Thaw overnight in the refrigerator and reheat gently on the stovetop, adding a splash of water or cream if needed to restore consistency.

**Is it gluten-free?**
Most traditional Butter Chicken recipes are naturally gluten-free, provided you use plain yogurt and ensure your spices are pure. Always check labels if you have severe sensitivities.

**What if I don't have cashews?**
You can substitute cashews with blanched almonds for creaminess, though the flavor will be slightly different. Some recipes also use a small amount of cornstarch slurry to thicken, but cashews or almonds provide a richer texture.

Mastering this classic Indian chicken recipe at home is incredibly satisfying. With these detailed instructions and tips, you're well on your way to creating a delectable Butter Chicken that will impress family and friends alike. Enjoy your culinary adventure!
